name: Qi Yu
source:
"The tide is about to rise, and this time, an oath will be sworn with Lemuria's blood. Let's reshape destiny."
"Did… Has the Traveler found his heart?"

An artist with a fiery passion for his craft, and is a rather easygoing guy. A bit of a jokester. Most of his paintings are centered on Lemuria, a civilization conceived by the oceans. His art style is like an inferno—passionate and fiery.

However, according to those who have once worked with him, his perspective on art is way different from what his works convey.
He has a unique and particular approach to his work and a distinctive viewpoint on art. It's said that he makes his own paints and must find a color he likes before he begins painting.

He set up Mo Art Studio in Whitesand Bay. It's his private art studio in Linkon City.

[Taken from [URL=https://twitter.com/Love_Deepspace/status/1722090003508174974/]Official Twitter account[/URL]]
